ConfigurationDeploymentModel.description:
Model for deployment configuration and schema definition.

Defines required and optional properties that deployments must provide,
similar to how ConfigurationProviderResourceModel defines resource configuration schemas.

Example:
    deployment:
      properties:
        additional_properties: false
        properties:
          environment:
            pattern: "^(dev|test|staging|prod)$"
            required: true
            description: "Deployment environment"
          tenant:
            pattern: "^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$"
            required: true
            description: "tenant identifier"
          region:
            pattern: "^[a-z]{2}-[a-z]+(-[0-9]+)?$"
            required: false
            description: "Deployment region"
      manifest:
        type: local
        path: ".strata/deployments"
      outputs:
        enabled: true
        path: ".strata/outputs"
        sensitive: redact

additional_properties.description: Allow properties not listed in the schema for deployments
additional_properties.title: Additional Properties

properties.description: Deployment properties schema (pattern string or structured field with validation)
properties.title: Properties

manifest.description: Manifest storage configuration. When absent, manifests are not written.

outputs.description: Terraform output artifact storage. When absent, outputs are not written to a durable store (they are still available within the current deploy run for downstream stages).

ConfigurationManifestModel.description:
Configuration for deployment manifest storage.

Controls where and how deployment manifests are persisted after each
deploy run.  When omitted from the configuration, manifests are not
written and a log message is emitted.

Path structure (auto-appended by the service)::

    {path}/{deployment_name}/{version}/{timestamp}.json

Example (local):
    manifest:
      type: local
      path: ".strata/deployments"

Example (gitops):
    manifest:
      type: gitops
      repository: "state-repo"
      branch: "manifests"
      tag: true
      path: "deployments"

path.description: Base path for manifests. Service appends /{deployment_name}/{version}/{timestamp}.json
path.title: Path

repository.description: Remote name from spec.remotes (required when type=gitops)
repository.title: Repository

branch.description: Target branch for manifest commits (required when type=gitops)
branch.title: Branch

tag.description: Create a git tag '{deployment_name}/{version}' after writing (gitops only)
tag.title: Tag

push_manifest.description: Commit and push the written manifest file to the git remote after writing.
push_manifest.title: Push Manifest

ConfigurationManifestModel.title: ConfigurationManifestModel

name.description: Unique name for the configuration resource.
name.title: Name

ConfigurationOutputsModel.description:
Configuration for Terraform output artifact storage.

Controls whether and how Terraform output values are persisted after a
successful deploy.  Stored outputs never include sensitive values as
plain text; the ``sensitive`` field controls whether sensitive keys are
redacted (value replaced with ``"(sensitive)"``) or omitted entirely.

Path structure (auto-appended by the deployer)::

    {path}/{deployment_name}/{version}/{stage}.json

Example:
    outputs:
      enabled: true
      path: ".strata/outputs"
      sensitive: redact

enabled.description: Write output artifacts after a successful deploy. Set to false to disable.
enabled.title: Enabled

path.description: Base path for output artifacts. The deployer appends /{deployment_name}/{version}/{stage}.json
path.title: Path

sensitive.description: How to handle outputs marked sensitive=true in Terraform: 'redact' (store key with value '(sensitive)') or 'omit' (drop the key entirely).

ConfigurationOutputsModel.title: ConfigurationOutputsModel

RemoteModel.description:
Model for remote source configuration.

Supports three remote types:

BUNDLED:
    - Platform-bundled modules available within the platform itself
    - repository: Platform-relative path ('.' or relative path)
    - reference: Version, tag, or branch identifier
    - source_path: Path to the module from the platform root
    - deploy_path: Optional path to deployment artifacts

GITOPS:
    - Module deployed via GitOps workflow from Git repository
    - repository: Git repository URL (e.g., GitHub, GitLab)
    - reference: Branch, tag, or commit hash
    - source_path: Path to the module within the repository
    - deploy_path: Optional path to deployment artifacts

CONTAINER:
    - Module deployed via container image
    - repository: Container image repository (e.g., Docker Hub, ECR)
    - reference: Image tag or digest
    - source_path: Path to the module within the container image
    - deploy_path: Optional path to deployment artifacts

type.description: Remote type: bundled (platform-bundled), gitops (Git repository), or container

repository.description: Source repository or image for the deployment
repository.title: Repository

reference.description: Version/tag/branch or image tag/digest for the deployment
reference.title: Reference

source_path.description: Path to the module configuration or script (not applicable for container type)
source_path.title: Source Path

RemoteModel.title: RemoteModel
